changes.title: Effects over trees
items: Hit sparks, glows and marks right by the witch are no longer covered by the see-through trees in front of her

changes.title: See through cull
items: Dense woods draw a little faster: the trees in front of the witch are no longer drawn again in passes that can't show them

changes.title: Ground cost
items: The forest floor draws faster: about a fifth less work for the ground each frame, the picture unchanged
